name: voltex
description: VOLTEX web platform, API, and shared domain packages

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.mjs && npm run db:generate && npm run build:shared
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @voltex/api" "npm run dev -w @voltex/web"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @voltex/web
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @voltex/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @voltex/api && npm run build -w @voltex/web
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @voltex/web
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @voltex/api
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c blue,cyan "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @voltex/shared && npm run test:unit -w @voltex/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @voltex/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
